title: When the Bridge Sings
author: Bram Yarrow
blurb: Sebastian Halloran, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
